title: Lentil: Temporal Logic of Actions in Lean 4
abstract: A shallow embedding of Leslie Lamport's Temporal Logic of Actions (TLA) in Lean 4, with the temporal modalities, standard propositional and temporal proof rules, weak-fairness and leads-to reasoning, and an interactive proof mode for TLA judgments.

informal.TLA.always: Defines the TLA "always" (box) temporal modality, asserting a predicate holds on every suffix of an execution.
informal.TLA.eventually: Defines the TLA "eventually" (diamond) temporal modality, asserting a predicate holds on some suffix of an execution.
informal.TLA.always_induction: The always-induction rule, equating `□ p` with `p` together with `□ (p → ◯ p)`.
informal.TLA.wf1: The WF1 weak-fairness proof rule deriving a leads-to property from a next-state action under weak fairness.
informal.TLA.wf_as_leads_to: Characterizes weak fairness of an action as a leads-to property between its enabledness and its occurrence.
